summary: Kolibri Global Energy filed a 6-K on 2026-09-21 announcing renewal of its normal course issuer bid, authorizing repurchase of up to 1,797,574 common shares, about 5% of the 35,951,495 shares outstanding as of 2026-09-18, through the Nasdaq Capital Market under board approval. The release also updates Clifton Mack completions and the Lovina 8-5-1HF False Caney test, with cash flow earmarked for debt reduction and capital returns. No price or expiry is stated; watch for actual buyback pacing, debt paydown, and reserve conversion.
